scoring_dimensions.buyer_specificity: 0-5; can we describe a narrow buyer and the situation they are in?
scoring_dimensions.pain_frequency_and_cost: 0-5; evidence of repeated work, errors, risk, wasted time or lost revenue
scoring_dimensions.existing_spending: 0-5; paid competitors, actual purchases, or paid workaround evidence
scoring_dimensions.market_gap: 0-5; repeated negative-review themes or underserved workflow confirmed by buyers
scoring_dimensions.distribution_access: 0-5; credible marketplace/search/community/direct path without paid ads or a pre-existing audience
scoring_dimensions.build_and_maintenance_cost: 0-5; higher means cheaper/faster to deliver and maintain
scoring_dimensions.willingness_to_pay: 0-5; actual payments or pre-orders score above opinions and waitlist sign-ups

hypotheses.title: CSV-first fee, refund and payout reconciliation for multi-platform digital-product sellers
hypotheses.target_buyer: Existing digital-product sellers selling on two or more marketplaces/platforms and already tracking income in spreadsheets
hypotheses.problem_hypothesis: Manual trackers may not reliably reconcile platform fees, discounts, refunds, payouts and product-level margin across multiple platforms; a narrow import-and-reconciliation workflow may be more defensible than another generic tracker.
hypotheses.current_signal: Competition is clearly present in general tracker spreadsheets. Public listings show products spanning Etsy/Gumroad/Payhip/Shopify; at least one Etsy result advertises CSV import but has only two displayed reviews. This is a question to investigate, not a validated gap.
evidence_to_collect: Use Etsy Marketplace Insights for buyer searches vs listing counts on payout reconciliation, Etsy CSV import, Gumroad sales tracker, refund tracker and fee calculator terms
Review at least 30 negative/middle-rated reviews of 10 direct competitors
Read official CSV/export schemas and platform terms before assuming integrations are feasible
Interview sellers already selling on at least two channels about their last reconciliation problem and time spent
Test an offer/sample with 30 qualified prospects and seek at least 3 paid pre-orders from unrelated buyers
kill_criteria: Most buyers sell through only one platform
Existing platform exports and tools already solve the problem with little friction
No repeated complaint about reconciliation or manual entry
No organic acquisition path or buyers will not pay

hypotheses.title: A narrow spreadsheet-heavy task for a small-business segment
hypotheses.target_buyer: One identifiable small-business profession or operator role
hypotheses.problem_hypothesis: The buyer repeats a measurable, error-prone task in spreadsheets, email, CSVs or a combination of disconnected tools
evidence_to_collect: Recent problem reports from at least three source groups
Existing workflow and time/cost of workaround
3 unrelated paid pre-orders or equivalent strong commitment
kill_criteria: A free incumbent solves it adequately
Buyer acquisition depends on expensive ads

hypotheses.title: A repeatable distribution workflow for a specific creator or freelancer
hypotheses.target_buyer: A narrowly defined creator, freelancer or small agency already trying to win customers
hypotheses.problem_hypothesis: A repeated content, SEO, proposal, lead tracking or reporting workflow costs enough time that the buyer already spends money or uses brittle workarounds
evidence_to_collect: Paid competitors and current price points
An organic channel the buyers already use
kill_criteria: Only creator-launch hype or generic AI interest

note: The generic digital-product sales/profit tracker category is a cautionary example: competitor density is visible, while buyer search volume and unmet need remain unmeasured. Do not build until the narrower hypothesis is confirmed by marketplace search data, competitor complaint analysis and willingness-to-pay tests.

initial_market_scan.method: Public marketplace listings and official help pages; not a full market sizing study

observations.source: Etsy Digital Product Sales Tracker search
observations.observation: Etsy search results page reports 5,000+ items and shows multiple downloadable tracker/spreadsheet products at low prices.
observations.implication: A generic sales-tracker spreadsheet is likely commoditized; do not build one without a narrower verified gap.

observations.observation: Etsy search results show 5,000+ items and examples of profit/fee/tracker spreadsheets at roughly $1 to $20, some with hundreds or thousands of displayed review counts.
observations.implication: There is evidence of an established category and existing competition, but the result count is listings, not buyer search volume or sales.

observations.observation: Etsy India search results show 95+ items and multiple cross-platform digital seller tracker products priced roughly $5 to $35.
observations.implication: Cross-platform seller operations is worth investigating more narrowly, but the listings do not prove demand for a new product or a specific unmet need.

observations.observation: The official tool exposes buyer search and listing counts over the last 30 days and currently allows 15 free keyword searches per week.
observations.implication: Use actual marketplace query values in the next validation step; public listing counts cannot substitute for this demand data.
